title: Mike Macdonald: I apologized to Sean Payton, comments weren't intended for public use

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald: I apologized to Sean Payton, comments weren't intended for public use
sources.description: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed that his comments about Broncos head coach Sean Payton in a recent interview were meant to be off the record during his Wednesday press conference.
